balls.text: Meredith knocks out the leg stump. Nortje gives Meredith the charge once again. But Meredith nails the yorker and the stumps this time
Hacked away to the right of deep midwicket. Banged in short at 143ks, Nortje gives Meredith the charge and somehow puts this offcutter away
wide on the crease, full and holds its line outside off. Mustafizur deliberately opens the face of the bat and steers it to deep point
back of a length and on top of off, 141ks, slapped away to deep cover on the back foot

down the track and holes out to Green at mid-off. Porel gives Benrendorff the charge. The left-arm seamer drags his length back and hits the bat as opposed to bat hitting ball. Spliced to Green who is right at the edge of the circle
on-pace bouncer outside off, Porel swishes and misses

short and at the body, Kuldeep fends it into the leg side and takes off for a risky single. Wadhera swoops down on the ball from short midwicket and flips it back to the stumps at the non-striker's end. Sharp work from Wadhera

Caught at short third by Meredith. Slower legcutter, floated on leg stump, Warner slogs early and top-edges it to short third. Warner isn't happy with himself once again. It has been that kind of a day for DC's captain
punched to long-off as Porel gets off the mark

Behrendorff has Axar holing out to deep square. Too full and on the pads, Axar picks it up with his wrists but hits it straight to Arshad Khan. He goes for 54 off 25 balls. Terrific effort with the bat from Axar
short and into the hips, shovelled away with the bottom hand through square leg
pretty full and outside off, slashed away to mid-off
pitched-up delivery on off, 140ks, Axar takes this slot ball and puts it over Green's head. Lofted away. Axar races to a 22-ball half-century. Ooooh, Meredith has overstepped
144ks rib-high short ball on leg stump, Axar looks away, swivels on the back foot and hooks it away past the right of short fine leg for four more
slower ball into the pitch, 124ks, Warner is early onto his pull and is struck on the rib-cage
Warner backs away, swings and loses his shape. He does not lay bat on ball. He isn't happy with himself once again
Green pounds it on a heavy length on off, Axar stands tall and forces the ball down to long-on
on-pace short ball outside off, hauled away to deep midwicket
banged in short and outside off, Axar belatedly bails out of the hook

Rohit has his hands on his head. Dropped at long-on. Surya has dropped it and ended up parrying it over the boundary. Axar miscues it in the air. Surya misses it and lets it burst through his hands. To add injury to insult, Surya has been hit on the face. He needs some attention
slower ball, deposited over long-on. 110.5ks cutter outside off, Axar lines it up and wallops this offcutter over the fence
shortish and on the stumps, Warner drops to one knee and drags a slog-sweep to the left of deep square leg
short and into the pitch, no room, jabbed away through midwicket on the back foot
wide on the crease, short and ducking in to hit the thigh pad. They cross over for a leg bye. Given as a run
shorter and veering down the leg side. Re-set the radar, Green
too full and on the stumps. Green misses the yorker once again. Axar sizes it up and fiercely drills it straight past Green
dug in short and on top of the stumps, drags a pull to deep midwicket. Warner brings up his half-century off 43 balls. Warner isn't happy with himself. He needs to kick into higher gear
back of a length and angling into middle and leg, clipped away towards deep midwicket
overpitched and outside off. Green misses the yorker, Axar spanks it through the line. The ball rolls away into the extra-cover boundary
almost a yorker-length delivery on the stumps from round the wicket, Warner hauls it away to wide long-on
back of a length and fired into middle and leg, Axar blocks it

Clears long-off and gets six more. SKY has misjudged it. He runs in as opposed to hanging back on the boundary. Axar goes over the top once again. Rohit doesn't look pleased with the effort in the deep
floated up on off or just a shade outside off. Axar manufactures swinging room for himself and laces a six over extra-cover. Driven inside-out
drifts in at middle and leg and then breaks away. Pushed into the covers
round-arm dart on middle stump, played back to Shokeen
on a length on middle, Warner aims for a reverse-sweep, ends up gloving it/splicing it over the keeper. Replays indicate it lobbed up off the thigh pad
shorter and into the pitch, hastily chopped into the covers by Axar
half-tracker just a shade outside off, Axar loads up and muscles a pull to the left of wide long-on.  The outfielder runs across to his left and fumbles, giving up four
on a length and outside off, heaved away to wide long-on off the inside half of the bat
off-stump yorker, stabbed back to the bowler
pushed through outside off, bunted back to the right of the bowler
tossed up and dips late, Axar skews it through extra-cover for a single
floated down the leg side, wide called
tossed up on leg stump, Warner drops down to one knee and sweeps it flat and hard over square leg. Chawla finishes with 4-0-22-3
flatter and faster outside off, Axar pushes a single down to long-off
another wrong'un, this time to the left-handed Axar. Zips past the outside edge

Chawla breaches the defences of Lalit. The leg stump is knocked out. Chawla dangles up another wrong'un, Lalit goes searching for a drive, and is bowled through the gate. This has been a fine shift from Chawla
speared into the toes of Warner, just short of a yorker length, strikes the pad and they get across for a leg bye. It seemed to have pitched outside leg
pushed through on middle, Warner backs away and scythes it through point. He hares back for the second
very full on middle and leg, 141ks, Warner drives it down to long-on
just short of a good length and outside off, 144ks, patted into the covers for one

Dropped at mid-off. After bowling a good over, Chawla shells a catch in the infield. Pitched-up delivery on the stumps, Warner manufactures swinging room and slices it in the air. Chawla leaps for the overhead catch but the ball bursts out. There's a mix-up between the wickets, but Chawla can't capitalise on the run-out opportunity either. He is late to pick up the ball. Warner is livid with Lalit for not responding to the single. No harm done for DC in the end
on a length and on off, sort of stops on Warner who scoops a drive in front of extra-cover
short and sliding down the leg side, loose ball from Green, Warner finds the release. He sinks to one knee and helps it fine of long leg for four
good length and breaks back in at leg stump, Warner hangs back and tucks a single through square leg
pushed through and dips at off, stock legbreak from Chawla. Dabbed through point with soft hands

another wrong'un, the finger goes up. This looks plumb but Capitals have asked for a review of the on-field out decision. Tossed up nice and full, breaks back in to beat the inside edge and ping the front pad below the knee-roll in line with middle. Ball-tracking indicates that it would've cannoned into leg stump
Powell stretches across for a sweep and misses, struck on the pad outside the line of off
wrong'un from Chawla, a crease-bound Powell doesn't read it and inside-edges it onto his pad
on a length and breaking into middle, Warner goes low and short-arms it away to deep square leg
dinky! Barely moved his feet, just opened the face and picked off the boundary past the flailing keeper. Up and running!

well held, running back at deep midwicket! Dhull took on the shorter ball with a flick off the hip but didn't get enough bat through the stroke! Wadhera watched it well, stayed inside the rope as he gathered over his shoulder, and that's a timely breakthrough for Mumbai
swished across the line, shorter from Meredith, not perfectly timed as deep square leg gathers
angled bat on the back foot, eased out to cover with an open face
cramped on the angle from round the wicket, and cuffed out to point. Awkward length to negotiate
round the wicket, tight lines back into the left-hander, and blocked to the on-side
fully forward and pressed to the off side
inside-edged, in a bit of a tangle on the back foot
full face and pressed into the off side to get off the mark

down the track and lofted to long-off! Pandey took on the legbreak with a skip to the pitch, but he didn't quite get there, and the lanky Behrendorff was well placed back on the rope to end a promising knock
opens the face as this one skids on through outside off, and jabbed to backward point
tossed up on the pads, swept to deep backward square
flogged out to deep cover, another single to complete a leaky over from Hrithik
punched off the back foot into the covers
down the track, inside-edge, beats the keeper! Technically a stumping chance, but only if Ishan had a glove in his foot
whoops, that's a horror wide, barely hits the cut strip!
Free Hit. Round the wicket, dragged down, and Warner completely miscues his right-handed pull! Top-edged into no-man's land behind the keeper. How strange!
pressed with a full face through midwicket, leaning out of the crease. Whoops, an overstep...
steps to the pitch, good flight from round the wicket, dipping as Warner clips on the up to mid-on
worked off the legs out to deep square
punched into the off side. A tidy enough introduction from Chawla
sits back in the crease and thumps the pull! Too short from Chawla, and Warner had oodles of time to pick his spot through midwicket
down the track, meeting the leggie with a clip to the on-side for another single
back of a length, looked like the googly, and patted in the air off the back foot, through mid-off
back of a length, gently turning legbreak, tapped off the pads to the on-side
back of a length from over the wicket, turning into the legs and tucked to square leg
down the track again, launched in the air, off the pads! A futile dive at deep square leg as the ball skitters to the rope. Powerplay done, and Delhi looking solid
steps into the good length and clubbed through midwicket! It's a more favourable match-up for the right-hander, and that's sweetly thumped with the spin, past the in-field
flicked off the toes, to the on-side
on the back foot again, cracked into the covers and this time there's a single on offer
back of a length, chopped out to cover but can't beat the field
tossed up and beaten past the outside-edge, the bails are whipped off but Warner's foot is anchored. Good turn, and in comes a slip
nudged to the on-side to complete another lively over
under-edged but four more! Meredith drags his length back, Pandey is caught in two minds, skewing an attempted pull past his stumps, and the keeper too!
bottom-handed biff through the line! Meredith's had some success hitting his length, but this time Pandey sees it coming and lumps his drive through long-on
back of a length once more, 142kph from Meredith as he ploughs an aggressive channel on off stump and draws a solid block
tight line, just back of a length at a decent pace, nurdled to the on-side
tight line, back of a length, blocked down into the crease
flogged off the back foot into the covers
nudged with the turn to the on-side
down on one knee, and swept straight at backward square leg! That's risk and reward in a nutshell, tossed up and swept hard, but can't find the gap. A vital breakthrough for Mumbai
back of a length, turns back into Shaw, who shuffles in the crease but can't time his punch to mid-off
tucked off the pad, tighter line from round the wicket
lands on the sixpence, and creamed through the covers! The angle from round the wicket encourages Shaw to open his stance and free his arms through the line. Battle joined!
here comes Warner! It's a thick outside edge, but he went at it hard and earned his rewards through deep third. Delhi are starting to stretch their legs a bit
clipped off the pads, closes the face on impact so it's not the cleanest of strikes, but it finds the gap well and races away through deep midwicket
drags his length back, hitting the pitch and jabbed off the hip to the on-side
easing into another drive, full face of the bat on the front foot, and gathered at mid-off
on the back foot, angle into the left-hander, tapped to cover
round the wicket, and hits the seam straightaway, climbing past Warner's inconclusive back-foot fiddle, and dropped by the keeper as it wobbles late
crunched with power, clean through the covers! That's wonderful timing, angled across the right-hander, just back of a length, and met with the firmest of open faces, lacing through the line
back of a length, nudged off the legs to deep square leg
swinging on a full length, into the pads, and clipped firmly to deep backward square
sharp bouncer, but too high as it rises across Shaw's bows, eluding his thoughts of a ramp
leans through a drive, on the front foot, meeting the wide line for a deep-set mid-off to gather with a slide
wider line, hint of away shape, Warner reaches with flat feet and can't connect properly
sits up, just back of a length, and flat-batted with gusto through midwicket! Rolls the wrists on impact and slammed to the fence
stabbed into the covers, on the front foot, neat lines from Behrendorff
back of a length and clattered out into the covers
back of a length, more shape into the pads and jabbed a touch uneasily, in the air past short midwicket
on the front foot and pressed down the ground, meeting the inswing with a compact punch through long-off. Lovely timing
cracked off the back foot out to deep point to get off the mark
back of a length from over the wicket, Warner is out of his crease to meet it with a push to short cover

David dishes out a desperate dive on the second and makes it. MI break their duck in IPL 2023. Not a yorker from Nortje this time. He bangs it on a hard length, punched down to long-off. David rushes back for the winning run, and dives. Warner's throw is too high. He should've fired it on the bounce to Porel. By the time the keeper gathers the high throw and breaks the bails, David is in. Joy for MI. Agony for DC. Another IPL thriller.
another terrific yorker on the stumps from Nortje, squeezed to midwicket. They pinch a single. Nortje breaks the stumps without gathering the throw
low full-toss on off, almost a perfect yorker, another top ball from Norje, sliced away to deep cover for just a single

another yorker veering down the leg side. Wide called. Porel thinks it may have brushed the pad. DC call for a review. When the ball is next to the bat, there's a spike. The wide call has been reversed
Dropped at midwicket. 146ks full ball outside off, David drags it in the air but Mukesh drops a straightforward catch in the infield. That should've been taken. The tension continues to build up
accurate yorker, ducking into middle and leg, stabbed down the ground for a single
Tim David launches it over wide long-on Pollard-style. Back of a length and outside off, another cutter, David stands up tall and flat-bats it powerfully over the boundary. Bam! What a shot
wide yorker, which is stabbed away through point
Green clears deep midwicket. Another slower offcutter from Mustafizur, grips the surface. Green hits it in the air, he does not middle it, but still clears the outfielder
on-pace hard-length delivery outside off, punched away to deep cover for just a single
another cutter from Mustafizur. He takes it away from the reach of David who swings for the hills and misses
high full-toss on leg stump, flapped away through square leg. Is this a beamer? Nope. They don't review it either
just short of a yorker length on off, but it's still a good delivery. Nortje keeps David to a single to long-on
full-toss on the stumps, shovelled away between deep midwicket and wide long-on
another full-toss on the stumps. This is clipped more or less straight to Axar at deep midwicket
just short of a yorker length and outside off, stabbed back to Nortje
low full-toss on the stumps, whipped away to the left of deep midwicket. David rushes back for the double
full and wide of off, swished straight to cover-point
shortish and angling across off, Green latches onto the width and thrashes it through the gap at point for a first-ball four

Whoa! Sensational catch from Porel. He throws himself to his right and comes out with the ball in his right hand. Given out caught behind. Rohit has asked for a review. Wide yorker from Mustafizur. Rohit jams his bat down on the ball. Not a bump ball. Ultra Edge confirms it. Superbly taken by Porel. Top decision from umpire Gough. Rohit throws his head back and drags himself off the field
on a length and outside off, possibly another slower ball. Rohit can only drag it away as far as mid-on
grippy cutter from Mustafizur, leaves Rohit outside off. The MI captain flashes and misses
shortish and nipping away outside off, Rohit forces it to point on the back foot
low full-toss on the pads, Rohit picks it up with his wrists and whips it away between deep square leg and deep midwicket

SKY falls for another first-ball duck. Caught at the edge of the fine-leg boundary. Short ball veering down the leg side, SKY picks it up and hits it straight to Kuldeep. This over started with 4,6,6. It ends with a double-strike
pitched-up delivery on off stump, another slot delivery angling into Tilak. But this time he slices it off the toe end to Pandey at deep midwicket
just short of a yorker length and on off stump, jammed back to Mukesh
wide on the crease, short and wide of off. Mukesh dug it in seeing Tilak charge at him. Tilak still adjusts and laces it over extra-cover for another imposing six
slot ball, on a length and angling into off, Tilak picks it up and pumps it over midwicket. Such a smooth swing from Tilak
Mukesh goes searching for the yorker, but the length is not right. Full and wide of off, Tilak manufactures swinging room and scythes it over backward point. Good start to the over for MI
slower bouncer outside off, hauled away through midwicket. Just two runs off this over from Mustafizur
another quick yorker outside off, Tilak chops and misses it once again. Excellent bowling from Mustafizur
on-pace yorker just a shade outside off, squeezes underneath the bat of Tilak
on-pace full ball on the stumps, driven straight past the bowler. Dhull swoops down on the ball from mid-on but can't throw the stumps down. A direct hit could've put Rohit in serious danger
another cutter, on a hard length and outside off, Rohit only gets an inside edge onto the thigh pad
Mustafizur takes this cutter away from the reach of Rohit. The MI captain had stepped out only to miss the ball altogether
flighted and outside off, drilled away to the right of long-off. Good save from Pandey in the outfield
chopped from a middle-stump line to Axar at sweeper cover
darted into the stumps, forced back to Lalit on the back foot
sliding into middle and leg, Tilak plays it back to Lalit
flatter and on middle from over the wicket, Rohit sweeps it flat and hard to deep square leg
pushed through on middle and leg from round the stumps, dinked through midwicket on the front foot
arm ball, fizzing into off stump, Rohit keeps it out
slower through the air and sticks in the surface, blocked into the leg side
full and pushed across off, Tilak waits on the crease and knocks it through point
darted into the top of the stumps, Rohit uses the inward angle and clips it through square leg
Rohit uses his feet, meets this pitch of this ball outside off and eases it to deep cover
speared into the pads, tucked away through square leg
pushed through on middle and leg, Rohit goes low and sweeps it hard and flat through backward square leg for four more
short and breaking into middle, googly? whipped off the back foot to deep midwicket
tossed up on the stumps, Tilak uses his feet, collapses his back leg and drills it inside-out over the wide long-off fence. Top shot
Rohit steps out, Kuldeep drags his length back and shifts his line wider. Slapped away to deep point
down the track and belted down to long-on
tossed up and turning into the pads, worked away through midwicket. Rohit notches up a 29-ball half-century. No celebration from the MI captain
on the pads and sticks in the surface, Tilak checks his shot and almost spoons it into the hands of midwicket
down the track and glances this 100ks dart through square leg
back of a length and angling in, another inside edge onto the pad

arm ball from Axar, faster and flatter, almost 100ks, keeps low and strikes the front pad first. Is this heading down leg? Not given out lbw. Given as runs as the ball rolls away into the fine-leg. boundary. The tracker returns umpire's call on leg stump. Four leg byes
darted in from wide on the crease, Rohit pushes out at the ball and manages an inside edge onto the pad
back of a length and pushed across off stump, Tilak stays back and clips it through square leg
veering down the leg side, wide called
drilled to long-on for the single. Halfway there
opens the face on the back foot and sliced to point. Not a bad over so far, that six notwithstanding
onto the front foot, takes the outside edge, and gathered at gully
crashed across the line! All wrists from Thilak as Kuldeep drops short, he's on the back foot and wafts across the line, hard, flat and clean into the boundary sponge
turns into the right-hander from over the wicket, tucked with the spin to backward square
tight line from over the wicket, whipped to mid-on with an urgent swing off the back foot
panowie! Sits up, back of a length, Rohit is anchored on the back foot and pile-drives his pull, up into the stroke and high over midwicket! A lively over, but ends with another dent to Delhi's hopes
pulled but doesn't carry to deep backward square! Advanced to the pitch, Nortje dug in the short ball, couldn't connect cleanly but got away with the miscue as the fielder rushed in
swivels into a pull but can't connect properly. Midwicket limits the damage. That was 149kph
leaning forward, punched to mid-off
leg-sided, very full, flicked hard off the pads but deep fine leg gathers on the edge of the rope
met on the front foot, a full-blooded flog through the line but straight at mid-off
punched through the line on the front foot, to long-off
head over the ball, dead-batted back down the pitch
turning into the pads, tapped to the on-side

pressed into the off-side, and there's the breakthrough! Rohit wanted to get Ishan off-strike to the spinner, and he did so with greater emphasis than he had intended! Ishan was ball-watching as his skipper charged through, point gathered to fling to the non-striker's end and he's not even in the frame! Yadav gathered well, meeting the third umpire's approval.
round the wicket, poked out to point. In spite of the run-rate, just a sign that the spinners can make an impact here
punched off the back foot, to the on-side
nudged off the legs to the on-side. A two-run over, to give Delhi some vital breathing room
slides back and across, jabbed into the off side
well bowled again, a probing angle from round the wicket, straightening on off stump and defended
tight line from round the wicket, dead-batted to the leg side
kneels into a delicate dabbed sweep behind square
swished to leg, pulling across the line

too short from Lalit, Rohit swats to leg! He simply walks across his stumps to pick his spot behind square. A decent over dented at the last. And that's a romping powerplay, more than 11 an over already
on the pads, nudged square for another single. The spinners are applying something of a brake here
has a wipe to leg, and can't connect, the keeper gathers with a hop
leaning out of the crease, round the wicket from Yadav, blocked back down the pitch
on the back foot, flicked with the turn out through midwicket
patted off the pads to the on-side
reverse sweep, and nailed! Picked off with aplomb, meeting the off-stump line with inverted hands and patting the boundary through deep third. This is a rollicking powerplay
back of a length, rocks back to tuck the single to square leg
thumped out of the full length! Hoisted across the line through wide long-on.
over the wicket to the left-hander, and blocked back down the line, hint of outside edge as the ball grips
back of a length, opens the face on the back foot and guides the single to backward point. Fifty up in rapid time
lovely ball, round the wicket, straightening past the edge as Rohit leans forward
turn, bounce, takes the edge, beats the keeper! Lucky runs, but runs all the same. Delhi keep flowing despite a better over
turning down the leg side
on the back foot, and punched to mid-off. Some brakes applied already
too short again, but gets away with it as Rohit swings hard across the line and picks out deep midwicket on the bounce
whisked to the leg-side, pulling around the front pad
dragged down, he'd given himself room so can't connect with a cut, toe-ended while off-balance, straight to point
round the wicket, Ishan strides forward and pushes with an open face into the covers
a hint of width, Rohit chases with hard hands, on the up, away through deep third. Perfectly calculated aggression
deposited over midwicket! That's liquid cricket from Rohit, fast and full, into his arc, and yawned up and over the on-side with an easy swing through the line
leaning forward and poked out to point
hitting the pitch hard from over the wicket, tapped to the on-side
pushed into the off side on the front foot
beaten for pace but four more! Does almost everything right, pushed across the left-hander, who stabs late outside the line of off and nearly detonates his own stumps!
tight line to see out the over, blocked on the back foot
tighter line into the body, nudged with the angle to square leg for the single
blatted off the good length! Kishan just plants the front dog, drives uppishly through the line, high over mid-off! Runs galore!
back of a length, opens the face, pushes on the up and accepts the deflected boundary down through deep third. It's one-way traffic so far
clattered through long-off! Kishan throws the Kitchen sink through the full length, and that's a confident opening gambit at both ends for Mumbai
over the wicket, shaping in to the left-hander on a good length, firm block to point
over-pitched, hint of outswing, met on the full and eased through long-off! That is an emphatic first over from Rohit!
better length, angled in as Rohit leans forward to block to the off-side
smoked over midwicket! Rohit's in no mood to hang around tonight! A skip to the pitch, a thwack across the line, clean contact and deposited into the stands!
leaning through the full length and clipped hard through deep midwicket. That's got the legs to go all the way and open the chase in some style
hint of outswing from a middle and leg line, blocked back down the pitch as Rohit walks into his stroke
back of a length, good pace, blocked into the on-side off the back foot
